summary.en: A young man called Fusaya Oide arrives in front of the Mouri detective agency, wanting to hire Kogoro to solve the mystery of the death of his father, Raita Oide. Last week at 4:30, Oide Raita falls asleep onto the floor, only to later die. At the same time, a robber enters the house to steal whatever belongings they can find. Kogoro and Conan then met An Oide, the daughter of Raita and older sister of Fusaya, and Io Oide, the victim's wife and Fusaya's mother. Suddenly, due to the shock of losing her husband, Io loses consciousness. Meanwhile the ambulance takes Io to the hospital, Kogoro and Conan see a strange woman smiling. Later, Conan and Kogoro find out that an employee of Tebai engineering called Yasushi Taira was the robber. He robbed the house while Raita Oide was sleeping on the floor. However, it turns out that he was not the murderer. So, the robbery-murder case was two separate cases.
